claim_evidence.beat: The interior scenes of Harvard University, including classrooms and this admissions boardroom, were not filmed at the actual Harvard campus.
claim_evidence.supporting_passage: The locations for Legally Blonde are not, as you might have assumed, around Cambridge , Massachusetts . Although much of the film is set at Harvard University , apart from a few establishing shots as Elle Woods ( Reese Witherspoon ) arrives in Harvard Square , the movie was shot almost entirely in Los Angeles .

claim_evidence.beat: Instead, many of the college's hallways and classrooms, including those depicting Harvard, were filmed at Rose City High School in Pasadena, California.
claim_evidence.supporting_passage: Still in Pasadena , the college’s hallways and classrooms are those of Rose City High School, 325 South Oak Knoll Avenue , which was also used for school scenes in Catch Me If You Can and Pleasantville .

claim_evidence.beat: Harvard University generally does not permit commercial film shooting on its campus, citing potential disruption.
claim_evidence.supporting_passage: Conversely, Harvard sees little advantage in allowing commercial filming on its grounds. “We don’t allow film shooting on campus because it’s a disruption,” Wald says.
